messages:
Oliver Grant: Heads-up - Helios wants countersigned MSA + signed orderform before POC. Must be signed by their EU entity, they want customer-managed HSM attestation, net45, and are asking for a 99.99% uptime SLA. Can legal/finance accept a proxy signer for the EU subsidiary? :eyes:

Sofia Alvarez: We can run the POC on Dedicated/Private. BYOK/HSM is supported only on Private. Need to know what type of attestation they expect (SOC3? auditor report?).

Ben Turner: Finance: net45 OK with PO and credit checks. If procurement drags, we can offer proforma/prepay for the POC. Also need the invoice recipient and VAT.

Oliver Grant: Uploaded their docs: https://drive.redwood.example/Helios_Orderform_v1.pdf and Helios_MSA_redline.docx

Rhea Singh: Quick skim: their redline includes: "customer-controlled HSM, quarterly attestation, and key escrow prohibition." Our position: customer-controlled HSM allowed only on Private; require independent attestation within 30 days after go-live; escrow prohibition is standard but BYOK export restrictions need security exception. I'll draft tracked changes.

security_bot: Security flags: data residency, encryption-at-rest, rotation cadence, key escrow. Reference docs: https://redwood.internal/secure/crypto-kb and standard questionnaire answers: https://redwood.internal/secure/qa.

Carlos Mendez: For signature flow they want two envelopes: billing contact signs orderform, exec signs MSA. DocuSign can chain envelopes. Proposed recipient order: ["billing_contact","legal_counsel","exec_signatory"]. For EU proxy we need a delegation letter/POA or a board resolution as evidence.

Sofia Alvarez: Confirming: proxy signing acceptable if we receive delegation + corporate registry match. For notarized POAs we prefer translated English copy.

Ben Turner: Who is the invoice recipient? That determines VAT and PO validation. Oliver pls confirm asap.

Oliver Grant: Customer says invoices to "Helios Analytics EU Ltd" (VAT EU-HL-6677). Procurement says PO will take ~12 business days.

Ben Turner: Finance will place account on credit hold until PO but can accept proforma if they prepay. We'll also require a signed PO to clear net45.

Rhea Singh: Draft counter for HSM clause: "Customer-managed HSM permitted only for Private deployments. Customer must provide independent HSM attestation from an approved auditor within 30 days of go-live. Absent attestation, Redwood will enable Redwood-managed KMS. BYOK/export requires explicit security exception approval." Adding as tracked change on the redline.

Oliver Grant: They also want 99.99% SLA with financial credits. That's our sticking point.

Sofia Alvarez: 99.99% is significant. We can offer 99.95% for Dedicated with capped credits. 99.99% requires multi-region Dedicated, active failover, and an SLA uplift fee plus a 12-month reserved commitment. Ops/Product must sign off.

Carlos Mendez: Ops: multi-region + cross-region failover adds latency constraints and cost. I'll model the required capacity and estimate the monthly uplift.

Rhea Singh: Proposed compromise: conditional 99.99% available as a paid add-on if customer commits to 12-month reserved capacity and accepts capped credits. That limits long-term exposure.

docu_sign_bot: Envelope created for MSA/orderform. Recipients: Rhea Singh, Oliver Grant, billing_contact. Envelope ID: env_hel_3a9b.

Oliver Grant: Customer asked for turnaround by COB Thursday. Legal - possible?

Rhea Singh: Tight but doable if we finalize KMS and SLA counters by tomorrow morning. I'll prepare tracked changes and route back to DocuSign.

Ben Turner: Once signed, billing will queue provisioning. If they want to start sooner, ask them to prepay and I'll issue proforma.

Oliver Grant: Next steps: Rhea to post counters, Ben confirm proforma/credit checklist, Carlos return ops cost for multi-region 99.99%, Oliver to request delegation docs from customer. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:
